results.joint_game: 18 exact restricted runs, all pure continuations under stated selections; independent latent-first replay matches. Funded one-target cap-2 adds feasible options but no selected research/wealth. Selection changes rents and scope.
results.pooled_recursion: 18/18 longer funded pooled-output cap comparisons solved; eight-target saturated cap-2 premium 5.967401 each; exact labeled-menu/cash verification; positive active-rival and physical manufacturing open.
results.embodied_game: Concurrent embodied competitive game: paid kits, delayed assembly, installed arm/mobile, local qualified recipes, cash, ordinary learning and successor menu in one exact dated two-market account. 32/32 matched cases; inherited-procedure manufacturing increases accepted jobs 7.5→10 and customer surplus 10.5→20 while combined terminal wealth falls 58→56 (higher-total pure selection); cheaper kits induce actual order→assembly→service and change rival research; matched cap-2 null. Positive active-rival cap-2, endogenous retention/scope, longer horizons and general mixed solver open.
results.funded_embodied: Four-date embodied cap-0/1/2 from zero solved under guaranteed funding and two pure selections via a cash-independent continuation quotient; all six yield wealth (160.5,159), 12.5 accepted jobs and customer surplus 22.5, with ordinary training and actual mobile-kit orders/assembly but no successor attempts. Binding-cash cap-2 diagnostic stopped at 300,001 profiles (33,480 solved states), not an equilibrium nonexistence result. Positive active-rival cap-2, larger recipient sets, rights/scope and binding finance remain open.
results.cohort_embodied: A joint qualification mask with one physical and two separate digital recipient markets preserves overlap; exact cash clipping works even with binding cash under a specified quotient-based equilibrium selection. 14/18 primary cases solved; eight labeled, uncapped, distinct-cost checks agree on private wealth. Funded split vs overlapping qualifications raises combined wealth 224→228 at the same eight accepted jobs and customer surplus 12 (highest-total selection); at B=7 the comparison is 72→74, with both firms' qualified counts unchanged and active financing. Three-date inherited psi=1 cap-1/2 remains a matched null (118,118); from-zero four-date cap-0 solves, cap-1/2 reach the 1.8m profile budget, not an economic null.
results.cohort_scale: Four-date from-zero three-recipient embodied cap-0/1/2 now all solved under both continuation selections: wealth (166,166) or (166,164), no successor attempts in any case. Terminal projection and funded penultimate successor dominance reduce cap-2 from 6,689,725 to 3,239,595 profiles and 17,538 to 3,754 memo states; unprojected higher-budget solve matches exact selected wealth and successor counts. Five-date batch exceeded execution limit; positive active-rival second-generation return, endogenous retention/scope and longer binding finance remain open.
results.cohort_rights: Endogenous archive retention, paid outside training/data and dated lab entry/exit now enter the same three-recipient competitive technology. 24/24 primary pure-game cases and 12 projection-off comparisons solved. With an inherited procedure 2, installed mobile and costly outside research, retention rights induce one ordinary-service archive→internal physical qualification→extra accepted job: combined wealth 347→348, jobs 12→13, customer surplus 18→21. At cheap outside research or binding B=9, rights add zero selected private value. With inherited physical archives, open rather than closed initial lab scope raises wealth 349→362 and jobs 13→16; without enough useful opportunity the lab exits. This is a matched rights/scope comparison, not an endogenous second-generation acquisition result. Three-date positive cases fix hardware, while two-date cash/scope cases allow assembly.
results.manufacturing_rights: Endogenous kit ordering and assembly restored to the three-date rights/scope economy. All 16 matched cases solved (15 pure roots, one exact two-action mixed root with pure continuations). Installed mobile rights premium survives (+1 private tick); a paid mobile kit without installed hardware makes rights unused. With installed arm and paid mobile kit, rights displace selected assembly; under the higher-total pure continuation rule the root has no pure equilibrium across 170×170 retained profiles. Verified mixed root retains with probabilities 3/5 and 1/2, wealth (171,169.2), 12.8 jobs and surplus 22.4, versus no-right pure wealth (174,169), 12 jobs and surplus 18. Lower-total continuation gives equal private wealth (171,170) with and without rights, but rights add one job. No selected kit orders or endogenous successor acquisition in these three-date cases.
results.service_window: Three investment dates followed by 40 or 60 independently resourced terminal service shifts: six exact prefunded public-state games from procedure zero. Both firms retain local physical evidence and acquire both paid successor licenses when permitted; ordinary contingent training, paid outside training/data, lab entry/exit and kit procurement/assembly remain feasible, subject to one shared investment slot per early date. At N=40 the cap-2 minus cap-1 combined private wealth is -0.125 despite more jobs; at N=60 it is +15.03125, positive for each firm (+7.25,+7.78125), with terminal jobs 232.5→240 and contested market shifts 112.5→120. Cap-2 acquisition via licenses, not internal development; neither hardware order nor assembly selected. The positive active-quantity from-zero cap-2 acquisition witness is conditional on the enlarged terminal service window, high outside/kit costs, prefunding and higher-total pure continuation.
results.internal_successor: Nineteen exact service-window games separate execution qualification from internal successor success. Two-date endpoint probability premium b(q-p)-p(1-p); original internal kernel ties ordinary retry at p=b=3/4,q=1. Improved internal development (one compute slot, success (3+old)/4), costly but feasible substitutes, N=60: cap-2 internally develops both generations from zero with expected attempts 3.5, zero licenses/contracts, combined private wealth premium 23.173828125 (both gain), terminal jobs 226.875→232.5; positive under lower-total selection too. Original kernel with costly successors selects ordinary learning; improved two-compute variant buys first and develops second yet loses combined 30.25; cheap outside qualification erases original premium and reverses improved one (-0.2578125). No selected kit orders; terminal reset block, funding, slot bottleneck and local archives retained.
results.staggered_window: Equal-total 63-shift calendar reallocation from (1,1,1,60) to (1,1,30,31) eliminates the +23.173828125 cap-2 premium under the higher-total continuation; both choose first-generation learning. Advancing the 29 shifts another date changes the selected investment to costly outside qualification and also yields a cap-2 null. Early digital admission and alternative selection tested; concurrent inexpensive-kit diagnostic is explicitly budget-limited if unsolved.
results.concurrent_window: The previously budget-limited concurrent cheap-kit staggered comparison now solves both cap-1 and cap-2. At fixed 63 shifts (1,1,30,31), entry date 3, and kit price 4, enabling one research and one hardware action concurrently increases combined generated private wealth 1850→2067.625 while accepted jobs fall 248→246 and customer surplus 496→492. Both firms order and assemble a mobile robot; in the concurrent regime both also develop a first successor and train on deployment archives, saving expected 2.0625 per later service shift at unchanged later quantities/prices. No second successor selected in either regime. The six exact selected pure games include an exact replay of the accepted costly-kit late-entry comparison, full retained-menu deviations, and forward dated accounting. Exact projected transition-class caching and two-pass profile streaming remove redundant continuation evaluations; this is not an unrestricted mixed or binding-finance solution.
results.global_equilibrium_thresholds: Globally reoptimized integer threshold mapping in the accepted four-block economy: balanced later service windows give no selected learning through S=8, two asymmetric pure root equilibria at S=9, and bilateral learning at S=10. The boundary cases agree under cap-1/cap-2 and higher/lower-total pure continuation selections. At S=9 an exact symmetric mixed root uses research probability 25/32 each, checks all 92 retained actions per firm with zero regret, and passes forward dated accounting. The exclusive S=10 comparison reaches an off-path subgame without a pure equilibrium under its chosen continuations; mixed continuation remains open. A fixed-profile affine incentive-region theorem and selection counterexample are proved; the diagnostic fractional crossings are not promoted to full-game thresholds. All 56 result records (51 distinct solves) replay exactly; 33/34 primary comparisons solve and one remains explicitly open.
results.mixed_continuation: The exclusive S=10 gap is closed by exact intermediate mixed continuation. At nine date-two public states under the higher-total pure-first rule, certified two-by-two supports replace missing pure continuations; at the first state, lab retention probabilities are 24/25 and 3/5. Concurrent cap-2 gives 163.625 each, 42 jobs and 84 customer surplus: +7.25 combined private wealth, -2 jobs and -4 customer surplus. A local lab-retention fee interval [0,1/2] is certified against every retained action at the first mixed subgame, conditional on unchanged downstream policies and prefunding.
